description: This header file declares a function within the ATen library namespace 'at' that checks if a given operator is a custom operator, not derived from 'native_functions.yaml'. It includes a reference to an OperatorName structure and uses macro-based exporting.

methods.name: is_custom_op
methods.description: Checks whether the provided operator name corresponds to a custom operator not originating from the 'native_functions.yaml' definitions.
